purpose: Teach: ユリ/蟻/死神/邦楽/半径/オゾン/ダシ/漢文

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがユリの花を持ってこられた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father once brought me lilies.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Gentle warmth beneath the wistfulness. Pause before 'lilies' — the detail matters. Voice trails slightly, as if seeing it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お庭の蟻を観察されてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you used to watch the ants in the garden, didn't you, love?
lines.style: Warm, tender correction-turned-affection. A small smile in the voice. She's remembering him remembering. Slight tease of 'love' at the end — genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫に死神の昔話をされた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father told the grandchildren an old story about the Shinigami.
lines.style: Voice softens on 'Shinigami' — the weight of old tales. Slight pause, as if he can still hear his father's voice. Measured, almost reverent.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、邦楽のレコードを大事にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you treasured those Japanese music records, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful gentle deflection. A slight turn in her tone — she's not answering his memory, she's offering her own. Warm but pointed. Small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと家の半径を測ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father and I measured the distance around the house.
lines.style: A small wonder in the voice — the oddness of the memory, the ordinariness of it. Quiet pride. As if that small project still matters to him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、夏はオゾン層のお話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You used to tell us about the ozone layer in the summer, didn't you, love?
lines.style: Affectionate slight confusion. She's gently lost in the web of memories — his, hers, who remembers what. Warm acceptance of the tangle. Soft on 'love'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが昆布でダシを取って下さった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father made dashi stock for us from kombu.
lines.style: Quiet reverence for the small care. The flavour is in his voice. Slow, as if tasting it still. A pause — this was love, practical and unspoken.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、漢文を読まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you used to read Classical Chinese, didn't you, love?
lines.style: Very tender now. A closing warmth. She's circled back to him — to his youth, his learning, his mind. Small, intimate smile. Voice almost whispered, but clear.
